title: The Sleeping Volcano
note: Cutaway series film 6 (16:9): a green island volcano on a block of sea, the -Y cut through the crater shows chamber and conduit; magma wakes and climbs, birds lift, steam turns to smoke, a gentle eruption at dusk with a lava stream to the steaming sea.
